zh.title: 印度航空任命Tewolde Gebremariam為新執行長
zh.summary: 印度航空任命埃塞俄比亞航空前執行長Tewolde Gebremariam為新任執行長。Gebremariam曾於2011年1月至2022年3月領導埃塞俄比亞航空。塔塔集團與印度航空董事長N. Chandrasekaran表示公司正進入關鍵執行與擴張階段。前執行長Campbell Wilson已於2026年4月7日宣布辭職。
body: 印度航空已任命埃塞俄比亞航空前執行長Tewolde Gebremariam為新任執行長。Gebremariam將接任該職位，帶領公司進入下一階段營運。
Gebremariam曾於2011年1月至2022年3月期間擔任埃塞俄比亞航空執行長。塔塔集團與印度航空董事長N. Chandrasekaran指出，印度航空在完成初步穩定與整合後，正進入關鍵的執行與擴張時代。
在此之前，前任執行長Campbell Wilson已於2026年4月7日宣布辭職，結束其在該航空公司近四年的任期。

en.title: Air India Names Former Ethiopian Airlines Chief Tewolde Gebremariam as New CEO
en.summary: Air India has named Tewolde Gebremariam, the former chief executive officer of Ethiopian Airlines, as its new CEO. Gebremariam previously served as CEO of Ethiopian Airlines from January 2011 to March 2022. Tata Sons and Air India Chairman N. Chandrasekaran stated that the airline is entering a critical execution and expansion era. The appointment follows the resignation of former CEO Campbell Wilson, who announced his departure on April 7, 2026, ending a nearly four-year tenure leading the carrier.
body: Air India has named Tewolde Gebremariam, the former head of Ethiopian Airlines Group, as its new Chief Executive Officer following a comprehensive search for its next leader.

Gebremariam served as the Chief Executive Officer of Ethiopian Airlines from January 2011 to March 2022. Tata Sons and Air India Chairman N. Chandrasekaran stated that Air India is now entering a critical execution and expansion era following its initial stabilization and integration phase.
The executive appointment follows the resignation of Campbell Wilson, who announced on April 7, 2026, that he would step down after a nearly four-year tenure leading the Tata Group-owned airline.

zh.title: National Airlines完成蘇格蘭至澳洲直飛貨運飛行
zh.summary: 總部位於美國佛羅里達州的National Airlines於2026年8月4日使用波音777貨機，完成從蘇格蘭普雷斯威克機場至澳洲墨爾本的直飛航班。該航程達9,849海里，飛行時間為19小時23分鐘。這趟為客戶Golden Aviation執行的任務，展示了該機型在減少載重下的超長航程能力。
body: 總部位於美國佛羅里達州奧蘭多的貨運與包機業者National Airlines，於2026年8月4日完成一趟從蘇格蘭普雷斯威克機場（PIK）直飛至澳洲墨爾本（MEL）的飛行任務。該航班由國籍標誌N795CA的波音777貨機執行，在完全未中停的情況下，費時19小時23分鐘完成總長達9,849海里（約18,240公里）的航程。
根據報導，本次航行係代表英國航空服務公司Golden Aviation執行。波音777貨機在滿載狀態下的官方航程極限為4,970海里（9,200公里），但在減少載重的情況下航程可延伸至約9,750海里（18,000公里）。總部設於奧蘭多的National Airlines目前營運由九架波音747-400貨機與四架波音777-200貨機組成的機隊。

en.title: National Airlines Completes Nonstop Boeing 777F Flight From Scotland to Australia
en.summary: Florida-based cargo carrier National Airlines completed a nonstop flight between Prestwick Airport in Scotland and Melbourne, Australia, using a Boeing 777 freighter on August 4, 2026. The flight covered 9,849 nautical miles in 19 hours and 23 minutes without any intermediate stops. Operated on behalf of UK-based aviation services firm Golden Aviation, the flight demonstrated the extended range capability of the Boeing 777 freighter when operating with a reduced payload compared to its full-payload limit.
body: Florida-based cargo and charter operator National Airlines completed a nonstop flight between Prestwick Airport (PIK) in Scotland and Melbourne (MEL), Australia, on August 4, 2026. Flying a Boeing 777 freighter registered N795CA, the aircraft completed the 9,849 nautical mile (18,240 km) route in 19 hours and 23 minutes without intermediate stops.

The flight was operated on behalf of UK-based aviation services firm Golden Aviation. While a Boeing 777 freighter has an official full-payload range limit of 4,970 nautical miles (9,200 km), its range extends to around 9,750 nautical miles (18,000 km) when flown with a reduced payload. Headquartered in Orlando, Florida, National Airlines operates nine Boeing 747-400 and four Boeing 777-200 freighters.

zh.title: 亞太航空六月客運量年減百分之一點一 貨運需求保持韌性
zh.summary: 亞太航空公司六月國際客運量達三千零五十萬人次，較去年同期下滑百分之一點一，主因部分區域市場運能縮減與票價上升。同期國際貨運需求以貨運噸公里計算成長百分之三點二，受惠於AI相關半導體與硬體穩定出貨。上半年累計國際客運量一億九千二百五十萬人次，年增百分之三點二。
body: 亞太航空公司六月運載三千零五十萬名國際旅客，較去年同期下滑百分之一點一，依據亞太航空公司協會發布的初步運量資料。該總部位於吉隆坡的產業組織將客運放緩歸因於燃油價格攀升後部分區域市場的運能縮減與票價上漲。
儘管旅客總數下滑，以營收客公里計算的需求仍較去年同期成長百分之一點一，顯示長途旅行維持相對韌性。可用座位運能僅小幅增加百分之零點三，使國際客運平均載客率上升零點七個百分點至百分之八十二點六。
國際航空貨運方面則呈現不同走勢。六月以貨運噸公里計算的國際貨運需求年增百分之三點二，受惠於AI相關半導體與硬體的穩定出貨。貨運運能僅微增百分之零點二，帶動國際貨運平均載貨率上升一點八個百分點至百分之六十二點六。
AAPA理事長Wong Hong指出，六月客運放緩因部分市場航空公司調高票價並縮減運能。他表示今年國際旅行大體維持穩定，亞太區航空公司上半年累計運載一億九千二百五十萬名國際旅客，較去年同期成長百分之三點二。
Wong Hong將貨運視為亮點，指出上半年國際航空貨運需求成長百分之七點零，歸功於AI相關半導體出貨及其他高價值、時效性商品的持續需求。展望未來，他提及中東衝突引發的燃油價格波動、企業信心偏弱及地緣政治與貿易政策風險，可能使未來數月旅遊與航空貨運成長放緩。

en.title: APAC Airlines See June 2026 Passenger Dip; Cargo Demand Stays Resilient
en.summary: Asia Pacific airlines carried 30.5 million international passengers in June 2026, down 1.1% year-on-year, amid capacity reductions and higher airfares following a fuel price spike. International cargo demand measured in freight ton kilometers rose 3.2%, supported by steady AI-related semiconductor shipments. First-half international passengers reached 192.5 million, up 3.2%.
body: Asia Pacific airlines carried 30.5 million international passengers in June 2026, a 1.1% year-over-year decline, according to preliminary traffic figures released by the Association of Asia Pacific Airlines. The Kuala Lumpur-based industry group attributed the softening to capacity reductions and higher airfares in some regional markets following a spike in fuel prices.

While overall passenger numbers slipped, demand measured in revenue passenger kilometers still rose 1.1% year-over-year, a sign that longer-haul travel remained comparatively resilient. That growth outpaced a modest 0.3% increase in available seat capacity, pushing the average international passenger load factor up 0.7 percentage points to 82.6% for the month.

International air cargo presented a different picture. International freight demand, measured in freight ton kilometers, climbed 3.2% year-over-year in June, helped by steady shipments of AI-related semiconductors and hardware. Freight capacity grew only slightly, up 0.2%, which lifted the average international freight load factor by 1.8 percentage points to 62.6%.

Wong Hong, who assumed the role of Director General at AAPA in April 2026, said passenger traffic eased in June as airlines in some markets raised fares and pulled back capacity. He noted that international travel has largely held steady this year, with airlines in the region carrying 192.5 million international passengers in the first half of 2026, up 3.2% from the same period last year.

He pointed to cargo as a bright spot, saying that international air cargo demand grew 7.0% in the first half of the year, crediting that growth to continued demand for AI-related semiconductor shipments and other high-value, time-sensitive goods. Looking forward, he cited uncertainty tied to the Middle East conflict fueling fuel price volatility, softer business confidence, and elevated geopolitical and trade policy risks that could slow growth in both travel and air cargo in the coming months.
